The Prophet told of a prophet whose people beat him bloody, who wiped his face saying: O Allah, forgive my nation, for they have no knowledge.
The Prophet asked mercy for Lot, said he would have answered the call after an imprisonment as long as Joseph's, and that we have more right to doubt than Abraham.
Ibn Abbas had not heard the Prophet say 'Kafir' is written between the Dajjal's eyes, but heard him liken Abraham to himself and describe brown, curly-haired Moses saying Labbaik.
Do not prefer some prophets to others; when an Ansari slapped a Jew for exalting Moses, the Prophet said he would find Moses holding a pillar of the Throne.
The Prophet told of one of the prophets who, beaten and bloodied by his people, wiped his face and asked his Lord to forgive them, for they did not know.
